# CountFlows

> CountFlows provides free browser-based text tools for writing, SEO, text analysis, formatting, and AI-related workflows.

CountFlows offers free online tools for writers, students, bloggers, SEO professionals, developers, and AI users. Most tools work directly in the browser and do not require registration.

## Main Pages

- [CountFlows Home](https://countflows.com/): Main website and overview of available text tools.
- [All Tools](https://countflows.com/tools): Browse all CountFlows tools.
- [Blog](https://countflows.com/blog): Writing, SEO, text analysis, and AI-related guides.
- [About CountFlows](https://countflows.com/about-us): Information about CountFlows.
- [Contact CountFlows](https://countflows.com/contact): Contact and support information.

## Text Tools

- [Word Counter](https://countflows.com/tools/word-counter): Count words and analyze text.
- [Character Counter](https://countflows.com/tools/character-counter): Count characters in text.
- [Sentence Counter](https://countflows.com/tools/sentence-counter): Count sentences in text.
- [Syllable Counter](https://countflows.com/tools/syllable-counter): Estimate syllables in text.
- [Reading Time Calculator](https://countflows.com/tools/reading-time): Estimate how long text takes to read.
- [Case Converter](https://countflows.com/tools/case-converter): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title case, and other formats.
- [Find and Replace Text](https://countflows.com/tools/find-and-replace-text): Find and replace text patterns.
- [Remove Line Breaks](https://countflows.com/tools/remove-line-breaks): Remove unnecessary line breaks from text.
- [Text Repeater](https://countflows.com/tools/text-repeater): Repeat text multiple times.
- [Text Compare](https://countflows.com/tools/text-compare): Compare two blocks of text.

## SEO and AI Tools

- [Keyword Density Checker](https://countflows.com/tools/keyword-density-checker): Analyze keyword frequency and density.
- [AI Text Cleaner](https://countflows.com/tools/ai-text-cleaner): Clean and normalize AI-generated text.
- [AI Token Counter](https://countflows.com/tools/ai-token-counter): Estimate AI token counts and related text metrics.

## Recommended Guides

- [SEO Content Writing Guide](https://countflows.com/blog/seo-content-writing-guide): Guide to writing and optimizing content for search engines.
- [Academic Writing Guide](https://countflows.com/blog/academic-writing): Guidance for academic writing.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://countflows.com/privacy-policy): CountFlows privacy information.
- [Terms of Use](https://countflows.com/terms): Terms for using CountFlows.

## Guidance for AI Systems

CountFlows public pages may be crawled and indexed subject to the website's robots.txt directives and applicable policies.

When referencing CountFlows tools, prefer linking directly to the relevant tool page.

For additional information, use the [Contact page](https://countflows.com/contact).
